faqs.question: What is the admission procedure for the upcoming academic year?
faqs.answer: Our admission process is simple and parent-friendly: 1) Schedule a campus visit or enquire online; 2) Tour the classrooms and meet our Head of School; 3) Complete the child profile form and submit verification documents; 4) Confirm enrollment upon seat allocation.

faqs.question: What are the age cut-off criteria for different programmes?
faqs.answer: The child must complete the designated age by 31st July of the academic year: Toddlers (1.5 yrs), Playgroup (2 yrs), Nursery (3 yrs), and Kindergarten (4+ yrs).

faqs.question: How are programme fees structured and paid?
faqs.answer: Fees are structured term-wise or quarterly. They cover curriculum materials, daily fruit snacks, student safety insurance, and activity kits. Detailed fee sheets are handed over transparently during your scheduled campus visit.

faqs.question: What safety and security protocols are active on campus?
faqs.answer: We enforce 100% CCTV coverage in classrooms and play zones, verified background checks on all staff, biometric/gatekeeper entry, a strict dual-card authorized pickup protocol, and on-site pediatric first-aid trained personnel.

faqs.question: What happens if my child experiences separation anxiety?
faqs.answer: We welcome gradual settling sessions! During the first week, children attend for 60 to 90 minutes, and parents may wait in our reception lounge until the child feels completely settled and secure.

faqs.question: Are toilet-training requirements mandatory for toddlers or playgroup?
faqs.answer: No. Our patient child-care educators assist children gently through toilet training at their natural pace with dedicated sanitised child-height washrooms.
